dominion.of.canada.unoffical: Pavel Unoffical reached S-C9 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-C9, Pavel Unoffical listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
imerv2: On Day 8 Isidor "Saint" Imerv took a post at R-S17 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hums hymns when frightened, and the men liked him for it.
Casimir Nile and Isidor "Saint" Imerv argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

Isidor "Saint" Imerv was carrying water up to R-S17 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Isidor "Saint" Imerv did not. Shot by Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor of the Hegemony (@andyincorporated). Isidor "Saint" Imerv smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil came out for a cup and was gravely wounded. Isidor "Saint" Imerv was hit at R-S17 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor of the Hegemony (@andyincorporated).
The papers connected Jakub "Bones" Imerv to Isidor "Saint" Imerv. The men took longer to learn Jakub "Bones" Imerv's own habits, but they made the effort.
jarbeefus_kong: Casimir Kong, a lamplighter from Halden, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in T-F10. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
joseph_austin15_: Emil "Spark" Austin arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Emil "Spark" Austin watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
oliversheppard1: Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa found a place in T-S7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
